2607.12375.title: IQA-T1: Tool-based Visual Evidence Reasoning for Image Quality Assessment
2607.12375.paper_summary: Image Quality Assessment (IQA) in open-world environments remains challenging due to limited generalization and interpretability. Recent approaches based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce textual reasoning for quality prediction, yet their judgments rely heavily on semantically biased internal representations, making them insensitive to low-level perceptual degradations. We propose IQA-T1, a tool-based visual evidence reasoning framework that augments MLLM reasoning with explicit perceptual observations. During inference, the model autonomously invokes specialized analysis tools to generate structured visual evidence, such as noise residual maps, gradient statistics, and frequency spectra, which are progressively integrated into the reasoning process. To support this paradigm, we construct Q-Tool, a dataset containing 11k multimodal reasoning chains grounded in tool-generated evidence. Extensive experiments on seven IQA benchmarks show that IQA-T1 achieves the best overall performance across datasets while producing interpretable and evidence-grounded quality assessments. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/zibuyu-02/IQA-T1.
2607.12375.paper_summary_zh: 影像品質評估（IQA）在開放世界環境中仍然面臨挑戰，因為其一般化和可解釋性有限。最近基於多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）的方法引入了文本推理來進行品質預測，但它們的判斷在很大程度上依賴於語義偏見的內部表示，使其對低層次感知劣化不敏感。我們提出了IQA-T1，一個基於工具的視覺證據推理框架，通過明確的感知觀察來增強MLLM推理。在推理過程中，模型自主調用專門的分析工具來生成結構化的視覺證據，例如噪聲殘差圖、梯度統計和頻率譜，這些證據逐步整合進推理過程中。為了支持這一範式，我們構建了Q-Tool，一個包含11k多模態推理鏈的數據集，這些推理鏈以工具生成的證據為基礎。在七個IQA基準上的大量實驗顯示，IQA-T1在各數據集上達到了最佳的整體性能，同時產生可解釋且基於證據的品質評估。代碼和數據集可在https://github.com/zibuyu-02/IQA-T1獲得。
